_fixture.source: hand-made contract fixture (feat/technique spec section 6); no /api/technique backend recorded yet
_fixture.what: GET /api/technique/sessions/<id> shape for a session with no reference lap yet: line and inputs unavailable, balance still computed (here: nothing recurring). Hand-made.

line.reason: No reference lap yet: drive a clean lap at this track to compare with.

inputs.reason: No reference lap yet: drive a clean lap at this track to compare with.

balance.note: Thresholds are heuristics, tested on recorded laps.

pedals.label: Fanatec CSL Pedals
pedals.note: Stock CSL brake (measures pedal travel): only bigger differences in brake pressure and timing are called out.

notes: Braking assist is on (medium): the game adds its own braking, so these brake figures are not all yours.
ABS on: the game prevents lock-ups, so they are not analysed.

setup.caveat: A setup is a starting point, not a guaranteed fix: rule out technique first (braking point, entry speed, brake release, throttle), then change one thing at a time and compare laps.

thresholds.text: A line difference is called out from 1 m (same-driver lap-to-lap spread is 0.7-2.8 m).
Further apart than this is off track or the pit lane, so it is not compared.
Smoothing of the reference line's direction.
Understeer from 3 degrees more slip angle at the front than the rear (real neutral range +0.4 to +2.9).
Oversteer from 1 degree more slip at the rear.
A slide: the car pointing 5 degrees or more away from where it is going, for 0.1 s.
A lock-up: slip ratio -0.20 or lower for 0.1 s.
Wheelspin: rear slip ratio 0.15 or more for 0.2 s with the throttle on.
A balance recurs on at least 2 laps and half the laps with data.
